article.title: Carmel stops licensing new art galleries
article.excerpt: Art is dead in Carmel — or at the very least, its growth is stunted. With a glut of art in the idyllic seaside village — about four out of 10 businesses [out of a total of about 300] are art galleries — the Carmel City Council is taking action to prevent new galleries from springing up.
